craft_notes: Sthāyin: scriptural seal. Sanskrit-first: maheśinā line-final weight. Rows: 2. Close: Lord's soul. Rejected: flattening tatra tatra — killed: the canon-list matters. Read aloud: sealing cadence.

lines: Ripe word, flawless work, highest and whole —
every scripture sings it, from the Great Lord's soul.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ pūrṇeti saṃśodhyahīnamuttamamīdṛśam | dīkṣākarmoditaṃ tatra tatra śāstre maheśinā
